bio: Richard Juien-Dah Pan (born October 28, 1965) is an American Democratic politician and physician who served in the California State Senate from 2014 to 2022, representing the 6th Senate district, which encompassed parts of Sacramento and Yolo counties. He is a practicing pediatrician and professor at the University of California, Davis. He is the U.S. representative-elect for California's 6th congressional district, having defeated incumbent Kevin Kiley in the 2026 election.
offices: Member of the State Senate of California (2014–2022)
Member of the California State Assembly (2010–2014)
